texts.zh:
作为我们[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]观测计划的一部分，绑架小队通过外科手术的方式在一部分[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]的脑内装入了植入体，以便追踪他们的位置，监视他们的行为。不幸的是，由于一些制造上的瑕疵，许多植入体失灵了，现在……我们的测试对象身上还出现了一些副作用。

有些测试对象自杀了，还有至少三个测试对象陷入了歇斯底里的暴力状态。我们观测站上的[root.GetResearcherPlural]请求协助，对剩余的测试对象进行管制，在更多事故发生之前移除他们的植入体。
texts.en:
As part of our observation efforts on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], abduction teams have surgically installed brain implants on a number of [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] test subjects to track them and monitor their behavior. Unfortunately, due to a manufacturing flaw many of these implants have malfunctioned, and are now having an... adverse effect on the behavior of our subjects.

There have been a number of suicides, and at least three episodes of violent hysteria. The [root.GetResearcherPlural] on our Observation Post have requested assistance in rounding up the remaining subjects and removing their implants before there are any more incidents.

label.zh: 我们得收拾一下烂摊子。
label.en: We need to clean up this mess.

texts.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]观测站的绑架小队已经与[Root.GetName]的人员展开合作，迅速地将有瑕疵植入体的[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]测试对象都集中了起来。

观测站的外科手术人员更换了功能正常的植入体，并将测试对象送回了[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]地表。不仅如此，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]还成功地从被移除的植入体中提取到大量数据——尽管植入体存在瑕疵。
texts.en:
Abduction teams from our Observation Post above [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have worked in concert with the crew of the [Root.GetName] to quickly gather the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] test subjects with the faulty brain implants.

The Observation Post's surgical staff replaced the implants with functional versions, and the subjects have been returned to the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface. As an added bonus, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] managed to extract a wealth of data from the removed implants, despite their defects.

label.en: At least something good came of this.

texts.zh: 我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的最后一批[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]测试对象，由于大脑中存在有瑕疵的植入体，已经陷入了完全的疯狂。很多人变得异常狂暴，嘴巴里怪叫着[Root.GetSpeciesName]为植入体编写的代码，肆意攻击他们身边的任何人或东西。
texts.en: The last of our [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] test subjects on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have succumbed to the effects of their defective brain implants. Many went completely berserk, shrieking random code segments from the [Root.GetSpeciesName] programming language used in their implants while savagely attacking anyone or anything in their immediate vicinity.

texts.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]已经自行对我们留下的深究植入体进行了研究。不知为何，[GetPreFTLLower]研究人员成功设计出来的工程化义体，比我们设计出来的版本能够更好地兼容[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]的生物学特性。
texts.en: The [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have conducted their own research into the neutral implants we left behind. Somehow the [GetPreFTLLower] researchers have managed to engineer cybernetics far more compatible with [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] biology than we were capable of.

texts.zh: 我们给[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的数名[GetPreFTLLowerPlural][pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]测试对象安装大脑植入体之后，遇到了一些问题。他们产生了一系列功能失常的问题，引发了测试者的暴力行为，甚至导致了受试者的死亡。我们需要在产生更多的问题前拆除这些植入体。
texts.en: We are having problems with the brain implants that were given to several test subjects among the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. There have been a number of malfunctions, resulting in violent behavior and, in some cases, fatalities. We need to remove these implants before they can cause any more problems.
